create.name: Dr. Martha Jo Atkins
create.bio:
Dr. Martha Jo Atkins is an end-of-life counsellor, consultant, speaker and author from San Antonio, Texas, who has spent around three and a half decades sitting with dying children and adults and the families around them. She holds a doctorate from the University of Texas at San Antonio, trained as a Somatic Experiencing practitioner, founded a children's bereavement centre in South Texas and later directed Abode Contemplative Care for the Dying. Her short book Signposts of Dying explains the metaphors, gestures and visions that often appear as someone nears death.

Her teaching treats dying as a natural passage with recognisable stages, which she calls the Map of Dying, and blends practical guidance for carers with room for mystery: deathbed visions, after-death communication and the sacred quality of the final days. She runs Dying School, a cohort programme for carers, doulas, clinicians and the simply curious, offers consultations for families and professionals, films the stories of people who agree to share their last months, and gives talks, including a widely watched TEDx talk. Through The Shift Network she also teaches a self-paced video course on the Map of Dying.

courses.title: The Map of Dying
courses.description: A self-paced video course in seven modules, sold through The Shift Network, that walks carers and companions through the physical, emotional and spiritual stages of dying. Each module pairs teaching with a grounding or breathing practice, and the recordings stay available after purchase.

courses.title: End-of-Life Consulting
courses.description: One-to-one guidance for people approaching the end of their lives and for the relatives and carers beside them. Sessions help with understanding what is happening, finding words for hard conversations and shaping rituals for the final days.
